provenance.boundary: This file preserves what the supplied search summary attributes to the account. Serious allegations about Tim Dooley are claims by the account, not findings of this archive. Exact primary post URLs and underlying evidence remain separate recovery tasks.

circulating or referring to clips TXT says are evidence

pushback_exchanges.txt_position: TXT denies personal involvement in Tyler's private life, denies having or controlling 'cronies', and says he has not broken the law.
pushback_exchanges.pushback: Tyler alleges repeated harassment, research into his life, contact with his wife and potential libel/legal claims.
pushback_exchanges.status: Reciprocal attributed claims; no legal or factual adjudication in this intake.

pushback_exchanges.txt_position: TXT says Wolfe follows mainly to argue, disputes that he called it harassment, and unfollows him.
pushback_exchanges.pushback: Wolfe characterizes TXT as narrow, scattered and overconfident and warns against rebranding disagreement as harassment.
pushback_exchanges.status: Useful for challenge-response behavior; not proof of either participant's broader characterization.

pushback_exchanges.txt_position: TXT repeatedly replies with sarcasm, accusations of gaslighting, demands for proof and status/identity insults.
pushback_exchanges.pushback: Steve says TXT is seething and unable to stop replying.
pushback_exchanges.status: Important non-Tim control case showing reciprocal personalized conflict.

pushback_exchanges.txt_position: TXT says his purpose is to raise awareness and keep X safe and cites removals from Spaces after warnings as campaign success.

pushback_exchanges.status: Strongest direct self-description of campaign purpose in this sample.

control_case_analysis.finding: Combative, sarcastic and personalized conflict behavior appears in unrelated disputes as well as in the Tim conflict.
control_case_analysis.implication: Hostility alone should not be treated as evidence of a uniquely Tim-specific hidden motive.
control_case_analysis.tim_specific_difference: The Tim conflict stands out for duration, repeated cross-context allegation circulation, third-party warnings, claimed-evidence distribution, host pressure and removal/non-association goals.
